I am an Earth Observation and GeoAI researcher with professional experience in geostatistics, public health and environmental management. I have recently completed the ([Copernicus Master in Digital Earth](https://master-cde.eu/)), specializing in GeoData Science, where my research involved super-resolution, using deep learning, of real-world thermal infrared imagery to asses temperature spatial heterogeneity in rivers.  

My research interests lie at the intersection of artificial intelligence and Earth Observation. My experience spans academic research, public health data science, geostatistics and remote sensing; working with organisations on solutions ranging from wetland monitoring to healthcare accessibility. Beyond research, I actively engage with the broader geospatial community for example through building open-source tools and automated EO workflows.
